description: a tall regal queen of eternal ice with long white hair, rosy cheeks and a warm human face, a tall jagged crown of ice crystals, a long deep blue gown with silver frost embroidery, plates of pale blue ice crystals on the shoulders and bodice, a long white fur mantle, a tall ice staff topped with a long ice crystal held upright in her right hand, seen from the side in strict profile: the face, chest, hips and feet all turned fully to the right, only one eye visible, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look: face, hair, clothes, colours and what the hands hold
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen from the side, facing right, upright mid-step; copy it exactly
